The '''Coronet Medical Center''', best known as the '''Coronet Hospital''' or as the '''Coronet Medcenter''', was a [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]], on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Description==
The Coronet Medcenter was the finest medical facility on Corellia. It had an under-the-table arrangement with [[Xucphra Corporation]] to provide it with top-quality [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]].<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20021003recovery|text=Making a Full ''Recovery''}}</ref> The Medcenter was specialized in experimental medical treatments.<ref name="SWG:C">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Starting Location: "Coronet"</ref>

==History==
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], [[Corellian Security Force]] officer [[Bey]] was treated in the hospital after he was injured and lost an eye in an explosion.<ref name="TEGTW AC 12">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-12-tales-of-the-new-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 12: Tales of the New Republic}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Corellia Times]] reporter [[Vani Korr]] was admitted to the hospital when she lost consciousness after falling off her [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] during an attack from the [[Meatlumps|Meatlump Gang]].<ref name="SWG:Ftootvs">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Find the owner of the view screen|Corellia}}</ref>

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] recovered there for a time in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], after she was injured during the [[Battle of Duro (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Duro]].<ref name="Recovery">''[[The New Jedi Order: Recovery]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Coronet Hospital was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
